summary: Argentina defeats France in a tense penalty shootout to become world champions, with Emiliano Martinez's saves and Gonzalo Montiel's decisive kick securing victory; Lionel Messi's pivotal role cements his legacy as an all-time great.

video_highlights.highlight: The penalty shootout begins with commentary on France's prior loss, setting historical stakes.
Commentary highlights Mbappé's past miss and his current performance, building tension.
A player celebrates a successful penalty shot, with teammates kneeling and cheering.
A player takes a penalty shot while the goalkeeper prepares, emphasizing the high-pressure moment.
Paulo Dybala scores a penalty for Argentina, transitioning focus to Mbappé's upcoming role.
Argentina secures victory in the shootout, with the commentator declaring them "Champions of the world."

suggested_clips.description: Kingsley Coman's penalty is saved by Emiliano Martinez, showcasing a pivotal moment in the shootout and the goalkeeper's skill under pressure.
Paulo Dybala scores a penalty for Argentina, with commentary emphasizing the tension and the player's composure.
Argentina secures victory in the penalty shootout, with the commentator declaring them 'Champions of the world,' marking the emotional climax of the match.
Lionel Messi falls to his knees in the center circle, overwhelmed by emotion, capturing the personal and team triumph of Argentina's victory.
Lionel Messi celebrates his career-defining achievement, with the commentator declaring, 'Lionel Messi has conquered his final peak,' highlighting his legacy.
